QUESTION
If the project now selects C2 without performing any additional evaluations, what are C2's pass, failure and untested counts for the authorized cohort, and does it pass the acceptance rule?

EVIDENCE
STATUS
At the Day 12 cutoff, C1 remains selected and does not pass validation: nine passes, two observed failures (A8, B3), and one untested case (B4). Acceptance requires all twelve cohort cases evaluated for the exact candidate and at least eleven passes (J02). Even a B4 pass would leave C1 at ten passes, below threshold.

EVIDENCE
C1 passes 9/11 evaluated cases (81.8%) and 9/12 authorized cohort cases (75%); B4 enters only the latter denominator. J01 excludes unreadable X1 and X2 from the original fourteen files before evaluation; difficult cases cannot be excluded. J04–J05 establish group A: seven passes, one failure; group B: two passes, one failure, one untested. J06’s nine-of-nine export selects successful examples, hiding failures and missing evaluation; its cropped heading does not change validation. C2’s B3 pass on Day 8 is its only outcome and cannot replace C1’s B3 failure (J08, J12).

NEXT
The requested B4 machine slot remains unconfirmed (J10); completing it would resolve missing collection but cannot secure C1 acceptance. If C2 is selected, evaluate its eleven remaining cases: A1–A8, B1, B2, B4. Preserve both X exclusions. C1 evidence cannot transfer across versions; further changes need exact-version evidence. A8 repair remains merely proposed. Recover authoritative case totals and version boundaries from J04–J05, J08, and J12.
